## Failed Tests — Detail

### ❌ Business Policy Lumpsum Specific Injury Cover (ACB-2941) › AC04: Specific Injury WITHOUT a companion cover → companion-required error

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC04: Given Specific Injury selected, When no other eligible cover is selected, Then error "Specific Injury Lump Sum requires one of the following covers to also be selected: Life, Trauma Recovery, Cancer, TPD, Business Disability, Farmers Disability or Business Expenses".
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. New quote, Business, activate ONLY Specific Injury (no companion), SI $1,000, Apply.
> 
> Expected: the companion-required error including Cancer in the list.
> Actual (current): the app OMITS "Cancer" from the list — "...Life, Trauma Recovery, TPD, Business Disability, Farmers Disability or Business Expenses". EXPECTED-TO-FAIL (Discrepancy Evidence Record filed).

**What was compared:**

| Check | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| Companion-required error matches the story (list includes Cancer) | Life, Trauma Recovery, Cancer, TPD, Business Disability, Farmers Disability or Business Expenses | The minimum premium is $240.00 per year per Life insured. \| Specific Injury Lump Sum requires one of the following covers to also be selected: Life, Trauma Recovery, TPD, Business Disability, Farmers Disability or Business Expenses |

**Assertion failure:**

```
Error: AC04 (spec expects "Cancer" in the list). Got: The minimum premium is $240.00 per year per Life insured. | Specific Injury Lump Sum requires one of the following covers to also be selected: Life, Trauma Recovery, TPD, Business Disability, Farmers Disability or Business Expenses

expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality

Expected: true
```

### ❌ Business Policy Lumpsum Specific Injury Cover (ACB-2941) › AC13: with business Specific Injury + MLC (Mortgage & Living) active, the MLC Specific Injury Support Benefit is greyed out

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC13: Given Specific Injury selected for a business policy, When I select MLC (Mortgage & Living) cover for the same life insured on any personal policy, Then the "Specific Injury Support Benefit" option UNDER the MLC cover is greyed out and cannot be selected.
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. New quote, ANB 40, Employed, Income $150,000 (MLC needs employment/income) — on the Personal policy.
> 2. Activate Mortgage & Living (personal). 3. Switch to Business, Life companion $200k, activate Specific Injury (SI $1,000).
> 4. Locate the "Specific Injury Support Benefit" control under the personal MLC cover; check disabled.
> 
> Expected: the MLC Specific Injury Support Benefit control is disabled/greyed once a business Specific Injury exists.

**What was compared:**

| Check | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| MLC "Specific Injury Support Benefit" control state (AC13) | found & disabled (greyed) | {"found":true,"hasCheckbox":true,"disabled":false} |

**Assertion failure:**

```
Error: AC13: MLC Specific Injury Support Benefit is greyed out / disabled

expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality

Expected: true
```

![Business Policy Lumpsum Specific Injury Cover (ACB-2941) › AC13: with business Specific Injury + MLC (Mortgage & Living) active, the MLC Specific Injury Support Benefit is greyed out](data:image/png;base64,)
